Read the parameter values of calibration runs

Source: R/calibration_summary.R
read_calibration_runs.Rd

Collects the parameters.rds files that the calibration runs leave in their folders: one list per run with the values tried on the calibration scale (par) and on the model scale (par_model), the score, whether the run failed and, for failed runs, the reason. The names of par are <name>.<position>, as in the rows of the calibration table.

Usage

read_calibration_runs(dir, pattern = "parameters.rds")

Arguments

dir

The folder holding one subfolder per run.

pattern

Name of the files to read, matched exactly.

Value

A data frame with one row per run and parameter value: run (the folder, relative to dir), generation, score, failed, reason, name, position, value (calibration scale) and value_model.

Details

The generation of a run is read from its folder name when it starts with gen<number>_ (e.g. gen003_atlantis_run_...), NA otherwise.

See also

summarise_calibration()
